proposed_capability: Extend the existing gardening host service with a bounded personal-inventory fertilizer prerequisite, observed ground/household transfer candidates, per-plant and native Fertilize All selection, explicit queue continuity and verified outcomes without a second scheduler.
player_save_control_impact: No game/Sims save changes, no unapproved purchases or transfers, no cursor/key injection, no remote EA connectivity, no autonomous queue cancellations. Player-goal precedence, needs/deadline gates, and screen admission remain intact.
expected_outcome: An explicit gardener goal discovers the eligible pending plants and real inventory supply, requests fresh evidence or a uniquely observed transfer into the selected Sim's pocket, and only after inventory proof selects one observed Fertilize/Fertilize All candidate. Each action rechecks the queue and outcome; normal Sim autonomy/side quests never silently delete the goal.
negative_tests: Ground or household fertilizer without observed personal-inventory stock cannot lead to fertilization
No transfer if player consent, supply eligibility, fresh capture or exact affordance missing
Partial transfer and insufficient stock preserve remaining count without fake completion
Native Fertilize All selected only when observed enabled and all required units are present
Existing task continuity exact-target dedupe and player overrides continue to dominate
One bounded proposal per evaluation, no input authority, no automatic purchase
Legacy gardening observations stay unchanged, stale evidence fails closed
Only verified plant outcomes count as completed; cooldown/no eligible plants is not success
rollback_path: Revert isolated branch/PR; no user saves, game installation, in-game inventory or live queue has been touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact hydroponic planter affordances, observed inventory drag coordinates, patch-specific Fertilize All, and real queue behavior require local Sims 4 observation
Transfer and action execution remain gated on independent game input proof and user-control lease
